headline: Kay Kay de Monkul Lookout Walkway / Gonzalo Verdugo + Carlos Seguel Arquitectos
context: Located in the Monkul Wetland, one of the most valuable coastal ecosystems in southern Chile, this wooden boardwalk was conceived as a low-impact infrastructure that allows visitors to traverse and contemplate the landscape without disrupting its delicate environmental balance.
